notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.unread_indicators_note: Shows unread counts and dots, and lets you mark conversations as read or unread.
notifications.open_to_view_message: Open PsstPsst to view the message
notifications.delivery_note_ios: To protect your privacy, PsstPsst does not link your account and device through a notification server. iOS decides when the app may check for new messages in the background, so notifications can be delayed.
notifications.delivery_note_android: Android can keep the messaging connection active in the background, but the system or device maker may stop it. For more reliable notifications, allow PsstPsst to run in the background and exclude it from battery optimization in system settings. Options vary by device.
notifications.delivery_note_desktop: Notifications arrive while PsstPsst remains running in the system tray. Fully quitting the app stops background checks.
notifications.privacy_note: These details are hidden by default. If you show them, they may remain in this device's notification history.
notifications.system_permission_note: Also allow notifications for PsstPsst in your system settings. The app cannot check whether system notifications are enabled.
notifications.permission_denied_message: Allow notifications for PsstPsst in your system settings to be notified about new messages.
notifications.unavailable_message: This desktop environment doesn't support system notifications.
notifications.dnd_note: Messages that arrive during quiet hours stay silent. They wait for you in the app as usual.
notifications.dnd_time_hint: Enter a time as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock.

key_rotation.purpose: Updating your encryption key regularly avoids using one key for messages indefinitely. If a key is exposed, only messages encrypted with that key are affected, reducing the risk of a large amount of message history being exposed at once.
